title: Weekend Swap

summary: To find out about other people's experiences and ask for further details.

summary: To make a polite request, respond to a refusal and agree a practical solution.

title: Make, Do, Have or Take?

summary: To use common verb–noun collocations in short personal examples.

title: The Missing Wallet

title: City or Country?

title: Table for Two

summary: To discuss an imagined situation and explore the consequences of a choice.

title: Regrets Chain

title: Who Did It?
focus: Past continuous and past simple

title: Picture Talk

title: Who Lives Here?

title: Body Idioms

title: Word Family Bingo

title: Shopping Habits

title: Ethical Dilemmas
focus: Mixed conditionals; hedging language

title: Product Launch
focus: Business vocabulary; must, need to, have to

title: Who Said It?
focus: Reported speech: statements and questions

title: When I Was Little
focus: Used to
summary: To find out about past habits and ask for further details.

title: Getting to Know You
focus: Present simple questions; question words
summary: To ask friendly questions and respond with interest.

title: The Best I've Ever…
focus: Superlatives with the present perfect
summary: To ask about memorable experiences and summarise survey findings.

title: Holiday Disaster
focus: Past perfect
summary: To sequence a story and respond naturally to an account of past events.

title: Gap Year or Straight to Work?
focus: Verb patterns: gerunds and infinitives

title: Party Planning
focus: Going to; some and any

title: Celebrity Interview
focus: Question forms in mixed tenses
summary: To conduct an interview and follow up interesting answers.

focus: Everyday objects; It's used for + -ing; You use it to + base form

title: Change One Thing

title: Greatest Inventions

title: Technology: Good or Bad?

title: Healthy Habits
focus: Health vocabulary; should and shouldn't
summary: To respond to an everyday difficulty with relevant advice.

title: Countries Bingo
focus: Countries and nationalities

title: What's the Time?
focus: Telling the time

title: My Morning
focus: Present simple (third person -s); sequencing words
summary: To sequence a routine and describe it using the present simple.

title: The Job Interview
focus: Present perfect and past simple for experience
summary: To ask about experience and evaluate a candidate against job requirements.

title: Around Town
focus: Places in town; is there, are there
summary: To compare two street scenes through descriptions and checking questions.
